finished_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper. Stage: D3 integrated composition, 2-3 layers, moderate detail. Scene: Two broad warm beige outdoor stone steps viewed from slightly above at an angle. One potted shrub sits on upper landing far right, simple ochre pot with readable elliptical rim and tapered body; yellow-olive foliage. Broad coherent warm-gray leaf-shaped shadow falls diagonally across landing AND over step risers with bends following planes. Keep shadow simplified in 2-3 connected masses, no intricate lace shadows. White background and few plant strokes. No door, house or extra pots. Palette: 25 very pale gray-beige; WG5 light warm gray; WG7 dark warm gray; 44 yellow olive; 41 dark olive; 95 ochre brown. Keep relative hue character, these are planning labels not calibrated exact colors.

Panel instructions: 1 确定台阶方向 — Pencil outline only, no final colors. 铅笔: 先画上平台、第一立面、下踏面和第二立面四个相接区域；同方向边线向远处略收，不逐块画砖缝。 Check: 能用手指沿平台—立面—踏面顺着走下去。 2 定位花盆椭圆 — Pencil outline only, no final colors. 铅笔: 盆在右上平台，先画椭圆口，再画向下收窄的盆身；盆底要落在平台平面上。 Check: 盆口有前后，盆身不是歪斜平行筒。 4 铺台阶亮面 — Cumulative state AFTER operation 4, earlier marks preserved, later-operation colors and marks absent. 25: 按面分别铺极浅灰米，最受光的一段平台边可留纸白；立面先保留，不用一色跨所有面。 Check: 平面与立面可区分，边线没有被厚涂糊掉。 5 铺台阶立面 — Cumulative state AFTER operation 5, earlier marks preserved, later-operation colors and marks absent.
